directly, so the dependency between them lives in one place. invoicing_v2

Figures out whether a given logging call would actually render stack
frames if it ran.

The presence of exc_info isn't the whole question: the logging module
treats a falsy exc_info as absent, so exception(..., exc_info=None) prints
no traceback even though the keyword is there, while a bare exception(...)
does print one because the method defaults exc_info to True. We walk the
AST node, look at its keywords, and decide based on that.

Computes which shard a tenant's rows live on.

Timestamp helpers.

Use utc_naive_now() for every naive DateTime column. Passing an aware
datetime into a naive column lets the database driver apply an implicit
timezone cast using the DB session's own TimeZone setting, so the stored
value ends up depending on which session wrote it -- a bug that only shows
up as a few hours of drift and is hard to reproduce locally. Stripping
tzinfo after converting to UTC avoids that entirely. This module also
exports get_current_timestamp_with_timezone() for the aware columns; do
not mix the two helpers on the same column.

Use utc_naive_now() for every naive DateTime column. Passing an aware
datetime into a naive column lets the database driver apply an implicit
timezone cast using the DB session's own TimeZone setting, so the stored
value ends up depending on which session wrote it -- a bug that only shows
up as a few hours of drift and is hard to reproduce locally. Stripping
tzinfo after converting to UTC avoids that entirely. This module also
exports get_current_timestamp_with_timezone() for the aware columns; do
not mix the two helpers on the same column.

Timestamp helpers.

Use utc_naive_now() for every naive DateTime column. Passing an aware
datetime into a naive column lets the database driver apply an implicit
timezone cast using the DB session's own TimeZone setting, so the stored
value ends up depending on which session wrote it -- a bug that only shows
up as a few hours of drift and is hard to reproduce locally. Stripping
tzinfo after converting to UTC avoids that entirely. This module also
exports get_current_timestamp_with_timezone() for the aware columns; do
not mix the two helpers on the same column.

Figures out whether a given logging call would actually render stack
